epics.description: Timeboxed findings, not production code. Each spike ends with a written result in docs/.

epics.summary: Signal capture in the serving path
epics.description: Every chat request leaves a durable trace joined to the operational log, carrying a confidence proxy, without adding latency to the token path.
A hand-built held-out set that nothing downstream may touch, and a runner that scores any model name the server exposes.
Raw traces become a clean training set with a contamination check you actually trust.
One manual fine-tune cycle end to end, fully recorded in MLflow. Automation comes later.
Nothing ships on a raw number going up. Bootstrap comparison, runtime adapter switch, tested rollback.
Run the loop enough times that the thresholds stop being guesses.

sprints.name: Sprint 0: spikes
sprints.goal: Prove the three assumptions the plan rests on before spending story points on anything downstream.

sprints.name: Sprint 1: signal capture
sprints.goal: Ten messages through the UI produce ten traces joined to ten log lines by X-Request-ID, with the latency panel flat.

sprints.name: Sprint 2: eval harness
sprints.goal: Score the base model twice and know the run-to-run variance the gate must clear.

sprints.name: Sprint 3: curation
sprints.goal: Run curation over accumulated traces and show the funnel counts at each stage.

sprints.name: Sprint 4: training and tracking
sprints.goal: One adapter trained from real traces with its MLflow run open on screen.

sprints.name: Sprint 5: gate and promotion
sprints.goal: Promote a winner, then deliberately promote a loser and watch the gate refuse it.

sprints.name: Sprint 6: operate and tune
sprints.goal: Three full cycles recorded, at least one rejected, thresholds set from observed results.

stories.summary: Spike: runtime LoRA loading on vLLM v0.28.0
stories.description: Confirm the pinned vLLM tag supports --enable-lora plus runtime adapter loading. Confirm flag and endpoint names against current docs, not memory.
acceptance: An adapter loads into a running server and is servable under its own model name
Commands recorded in docs/

stories.summary: Spike: can the trainer share the GPU with vLLM
stories.description: vLLM claims 0.90 of VRAM (docker-compose.yml). Measure whether a 7B LoRA train runs alongside a shrunk vLLM or whether serving must stop. This decides whether the loop is continuous or batched.
acceptance: A written answer with a VRAM number
Decision recorded: co-resident or stop-train-restart

stories.description: Capture one streamed completion with logprobs enabled and record the actual delta structure.
acceptance: A sample chunk saved in docs/
Confidence proxy formula written down

stories.description: As an operator, I want a durable store for request/response traces, so failures can be analysed after the fact.
acceptance: Postgres service in docker-compose.yml, internal only, no ports: (matches docs/architecture.md security boundary)
Schema holds request_id, timestamp, messages, response, model name, mean logprob, nullable judge_score and curation_status
Schema is a checked-in migration, not hand-applied SQL

stories.summary: Capture response text and logprobs in the stream
stories.description: As the pipeline, I want the assistant response and its token logprobs recorded, so low-confidence outputs can be found later.
acceptance: _build_payload (api/app/vllm_client.py) requests logprobs behind a config flag
stream_chat accumulates text and logprobs while still yielding each line unchanged
Test asserts the first chunk is yielded before any trace work happens

stories.summary: Async trace writer off the request path
stories.description: As a user, I want tracing to never slow down my chat, so the streaming experience is unchanged.
acceptance: Trace writes happen after the stream closes, off the request path
A store that is down or slow drops the trace and increments a counter rather than failing or delaying the request
Test covers the store-unavailable path

stories.description: As an operator, I want trace volume and failures on the dashboard, so silent data loss is visible.
acceptance: traces_written_total and trace_write_failures_total counters
Scraped by the existing api job in metrics/prometheus.yml
Grafana panel added

stories.description: As the gate, I want a hand-built held-out set, so improvement is measured against something the training data has never seen. Written by hand, not generated. Budget a full evening.
acceptance: 50 prompts in versioned JSONL under pipeline/eval/
One narrow domain
Each prompt lists the qualities a good answer must have
Checked into git as data

stories.description: As the gate, I want a rubric-based judge, so soft quality has a numeric score.
acceptance: Rubric is a versioned file
Re-running the same set twice moves the mean by less than a documented tolerance

stories.summary: Eval runner CLI scoring any served model name
stories.description: As an operator, I want to score any served model by name, so base and candidate use the identical code path.
acceptance: pipeline/eval CLI takes a model name and an eval set, writes per-prompt scores
Same command works for base and adapter, no branching

stories.description: As the gate, I want a recorded baseline, so every later comparison has a reference.
acceptance: Base model scored on the full set
Results committed
Number appears in the final README metric

stories.description: As the pipeline, I want failures selected by configurable thresholds, so Sprint 6 can tune them without a code change.
acceptance: Traces selected by judge score below threshold or mean logprob below threshold
Both thresholds live in config

stories.description: As the pipeline, I want near-identical failures collapsed, so the training set is not dominated by one repeated case.
acceptance: sentence-transformers embeddings, cosine similarity above threshold collapses to one example
Runs on CPU in the worker, never on the GPU

stories.summary: Contamination check against the eval set
stories.description: As the gate, I want no training example near an eval prompt, so eval scores cannot be inflated by leakage. Pointed at 5 because the bug it prevents is invisible until eval scores look too good.
acceptance: No curated example exceeds the similarity threshold against any eval prompt
Test suite plants a near-duplicate phrased differently enough that exact matching would miss it, and the check catches it

stories.description: As the pipeline, I want obvious garbage dropped, so the training set contains only usable examples.
acceptance: Truncated, empty, and max_tokens-hit responses are dropped
Counts logged per drop reason

stories.description: As a training run, I want to name exactly which dataset I consumed, so runs are reproducible.
acceptance: Curated examples export to JSONL
Content hash recorded alongside

stories.description: As an operator, I want experiment tracking reachable over the existing tunnel, so every run is recorded.
acceptance: MLflow in docker-compose.yml bound to 127.0.0.1 like Grafana
docs/commands.md gains the tunnel line

stories.description: As the pipeline, I want a PEFT/TRL LoRA train against the curated JSONL, so an adapter is produced.
acceptance: Adapter written to a volume shared with the vllm service
Behind a Compose profile so a normal docker compose up never starts it

stories.description: As an operator, I want a documented handoff between serving and training, implementing whatever S0-2 found.
acceptance: If serving must stop: script stops it, trains, restarts, waits for the health gate
Failure mid-train leaves the serving stack recoverable

stories.description: As the gate, I want every run to name its inputs, so a promotion can be traced back to its data.
acceptance: Dataset hash, hyperparameters, base model, adapter path, wall-clock and GPU cost logged
A run with no dataset hash is a failed run

stories.summary: Serve base and candidate side by side
stories.description: As the gate, I want both models served concurrently, so they are scored by the same runner in one pass.
acceptance: Both served under distinct model names
Scored by the Sprint 2 runner in one pass
No redeploy, no model swap during eval

stories.description: As the gate, I want a statistical bar for promotion, so a slightly higher raw number does not ship.
acceptance: Bootstrap confidence interval on the score difference
Promotion requires the interval to exclude zero at a documented level
Bar is config; reasoning written down
A rejection logs why, with the interval

stories.summary: Active adapter as runtime state in the api
stories.description: As the api, I want to resolve the active adapter per request from shared state, so a promotion takes effect without a restart. Touches the hot path; most likely story to spill.
acceptance: Not read from the import-time settings singleton (api/app/config.py)
Cached with a short TTL, no DB round trip per message
Test covers cache expiry and store-unavailable fallback to last known good adapter

stories.description: As an operator, I want single-command promote and rollback, so a bad adapter can be reverted in seconds.
acceptance: Promote sets active adapter and records the transition
Rollback restores the previous adapter
Rollback tested by promoting a known-worse adapter and reverting

stories.description: As an operator, I want gate history on the dashboard, so promotions and rejections are visible over time.
acceptance: Panels for eval score over time, promotion/rejection history, failure-signal rate

stories.description: As the loop, I want realistic synthetic traffic, so failures accumulate at a realistic rate.
acceptance: scripts/loadtest.py samples from a prompt bank instead of the single hardcoded PROMPT
Bank covers the target domain with a realistic failure rate

stories.description: As the gate, I want a broader eval set the training data does not target, so catastrophic forgetting is caught before promotion.
acceptance: Second eval set run alongside the main gate
A candidate that wins the target set but regresses here is rejected

stories.description: As the project, I want the loop exercised end to end, so edge cases surface.
acceptance: Three end-to-end cycles completed, each recorded in MLflow
At least one rejected by the gate

stories.description: As the project, I want thresholds set from observed results and metrics in the README, so the resume bullet is defensible.
acceptance: Thresholds adjusted with reasoning recorded
README updated with cycles run, score delta, rejections, signal-to-decision time, GPU cost per cycle
